title: Train a policy on the implicit reward
brief: Build the implicit reward, the DPO loss, and its gradient on top of the Bradley-Terry functions you already wrote, and watch the unknown normaliser cancel.
hints: implicit_reward is beta * (policy_logps - ref_logps), elementwise, for whatever shape you are given.
dpo_loss: compute implicit_reward for the chosen answers and for the rejected answers, then return bradley_terry_loss(r_chosen, r_rejected).

dpo_grad: the loss depends on the policy log probabilities only through the implicit rewards, and each reward moves by beta per unit of log probability. So multiply both arrays returned by bradley_terry_grad(r_chosen, r_rejected) by beta.
